name: project-monitoring
//: Two clients over one API. The workspace exists so both can import shared/ and still find react and redux, which files above an app's own folder cannot do on their own.
//overrides: One copy of React for the whole workspace. Files in shared/ resolve it from here, and a hook called across two copies of React does not work. Without this an optional peer range pulls a second, newer copy to the root while both apps pin the version React Native is built against.

scripts.//lint: From the root, because most of the client code now lives in shared/ and linting one app's folder would miss it.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace mobile && npm run build --workspace frontend
